entry.title: BILL011(26) (Honolulu): PUBLISH → HHP
entry.content:
RELATING TO AFFORDABLE HOUSING INCENTIVES.

Requires the HLM to submit semi-annual reports detailing all types of incentives, along with the total amount and value of each incentive, received by every affordable housing project that has received one or more incentives from the City.

Status: PUBLISH → HHP

Latest action: Meeting cancelled.
